zh: 请问这门课还能加选吗？
old_en: Can I still sign up for this course?
new_en: Can I still add this course?

zh: 我想选一些跟计算机相关的课程。
old_en: I want to take some classes related to computer science.
new_en: I want to take some computer-related classes.

zh: 我打算选修一些跟文学有关的课程。
old_en: I plan to take some courses related to literature.
new_en: I plan to take some literature courses.

zh: 这门课有多少学分？
old_en: How many credits is this course worth?
new_en: How many credits is this course worth?

zh: 选这门课能拿到几个学分？
old_en: How many credits can I get from this course?
new_en: How many credits can I get for this course?

zh: 这学期我的课程排得有点紧。
old_en: This semester, my schedule is a bit tight.
new_en: My schedule is a bit tight this semester.

zh: 这个学期我已经选了太多课了。
old_en: I've already signed up for too many classes this semester.
new_en: I have already taken too many classes this semester.

zh: 你可以帮我复印一下课堂笔记吗？
old_en: Can you help me make a copy of the class notes?
new_en: Can you help me photocopy my class notes?

zh: 你能借我你的课堂笔记看看吗？
old_en: Can I borrow your class notes to take a look?
new_en: Can I borrow your class notes to look at?

zh: 作业提交到老师的邮箱吗？
old_en: Do we submit the homework to the teacher's email?
new_en: Do we submit the homework to the teacher's email?

zh: 作业什么时候截止提交？
old_en: When is the deadline for submitting the homework?
new_en: When is the homework due?

zh: 考试前我要复习两周时间。
old_en: I need to study for two weeks before the exam.
new_en: I need to review for two weeks before the exam.

zh: 考试前我会每天复习四个小时。
old_en: I studied for four hours every day before the exam.
new_en: I will study for four hours every day before the exam.

zh: 我想申请换一门课可以吗？
old_en: Can I apply to switch to another course, please?
new_en: Can I switch to another course?

zh: 我要退选这门课，请问可以吗？
old_en: I want to drop this course. May I do that?
new_en: I want to drop this course. Is that okay?

zh: 我要办理成绩单和在读证明。
old_en: I need to get my transcript and a certificate of enrollment.
new_en: I need to get my transcript and certificate of enrollment.

zh: 我需要申请一份成绩单和在读证明。
old_en: I need to apply for a transcript and a certificate of enrollment.
new_en: I need to apply for a transcript and certificate of enrollment.

zh: 图书馆自习室的开放时间是几点到几点？
old_en: What are the opening hours for the library study room?
new_en: What are the opening hours for the library study room?

zh: 自习室有什么规定吗？
old_en: Are there any rules for the study room?
new_en: Are there any rules for the study room?

zh: 我想把课都排在上午。
old_en: I want to schedule all my classes in the morning.
new_en: I want to schedule all my classes in the morning.
